closed: Prior admission, shutdown and takeover state-preservation findings are closed; 388 recorded tests and production hashes match.

finding.summary: The in-flight commands.send call holds the same lock that request_takeover needs. A user request during G3 preflight cannot fence immediately, so a deliver frame can be submitted after the user invoked takeover but before the durable fence commits.
finding.support: BoundMailboxCommandAdapter and PauseCoordinator do not independently consult lifecycle takeover intent at the final G3 submission boundary.
finding.required_behavior: Set a synchronous takeover-intent fence before waiting for the lock and combine it with the real transport authority check immediately before G3 submission, preserving unknown/already-delivered evidence without replay.

acceptance.C-AC-18: not met due post-invocation delivery race; external OMP pending
